confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, booking pages, or listings; July 2026 prices are projected. Restaurant and cafe anchors are more reliable than lodging, which swings widely with peak-season demand. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the draft beer price because direct knowledge is weaker. USD levels assume a mid-2026 euro-dollar rate. No verified RBA USD/AUD observation could be retrieved, so fx is null rather than estimated.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Rome's own price levels in central tourist districts, benchmarked against comparable large Italian tourist cities such as Florence and Milan; lodging adjusted for July peak demand.
